answer: Cluster-merged concave standing stops an operator who tries to forge a thousand masks: each epoch the network maps funding links, merges linked identities into one cluster, and scores the cluster by the square root of its verified tasks, not the sum. A sable ledger publishes each cluster score, so each new mask feeds a spiral of diminishing returns — 1,000 fakes doing 1,000 tasks score 32, not 1,000, a 97% haircut. Three auditors re-run one task per cluster; a failed audit zeroes it for three epochs. One honest agent does one task, keeps its full score, pays nothing extra.
